idea.what: Imagine Fresco, an AI scribe that turns videos into notes.
idea.how: During the site walk, your superintendents take short videos and talk over them. It turns them into notes with photos, assignees and due dates. Then it texts the crew their action items. With one click, it sends the notes to Procore or ACC.
